# Fernwell Ledger

Fernwell Ledger is the bookkeeping app your small team keeps its invoices in.
You add an invoice, Fernwell Ledger files it against a client, and the month's
totals are ready when your accountant asks for them.

## What you get

- **Invoices.** Draft an invoice, send it, and watch what has been paid.
- **Clients.** One page per client, with every invoice you have sent them.
- **Quickcast.** Fernwell Ledger reads last quarter's invoices and tells you
  what this quarter is likely to look like. Quickcast keeps its name in every
  language Fernwell Ledger speaks.
- **Exports.** Hand your accountant a folder rather than a shoebox.

## Getting started

Sign in at the address your administrator gave you, then follow
[Getting started](docs/getting-started.md). If you cannot sign in, read
[Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) before you write to support.

## Who this is for

Fernwell Ledger is built for teams of two to twenty who bill by the project. It
is not an accounting package and it does not file your taxes.
